description: Use this when the user asks how to make a cocktail they name, or wants its recipe, ingredients or steps, for example "How do I make an Espresso Martini?" or "What goes in an Old Fashioned?". Gets that recipe from the Garçon catalogue by name, slug or fixmeadrinkapp.com recipe URL: description, glass, ice, garnish, ingredient amounts (oz with ml), steps, strength and its fixmeadrinkapp.com page. Do not use it when the user lists ingredients and asks what they can make (use find_cocktails_by_ingredients). For premium recipes the ingredient list is not public; the result says so and lists free recipes like it. Recipes are for adults of legal drinking age. It does not give health or nutrition advice.

strength.description: Non Alcoholic, Low, Medium, Strong or Very Strong
